idea-plugin.name: SpringGraph
idea-plugin.description:
Shows the results of the SpringGraph annotation processor, which checks a supported subset of Spring constructor injection at compile time.

  • Gutter icons on constructor parameters of Spring components: validated (click to go to the chosen bean), runtime boundary, Spring Data repository, @Value, unsupported, missing or ambiguous (click to see the candidates).
  • SpringGraph tool window: the dependency graph per module, every finding (SG001 to SG009) with navigation to the source, excluded classes, and the share of statically validated dependencies.

The plugin does not analyse code itself. It reads META-INF/springgraph/graph.json, which the processor writes on every compile, and refreshes after each build. So what you see is exactly what the build reported, including a failed strict build. Requires the processor (io.github.mrsluffy:springgraph-processor) with -Aspringgraph.mode=advisory or strict in your Gradle or Maven build.

Experimental. Icons are hidden for a constructor that changed since the last build.

action.description: Re-read the SpringGraph reports written by the last build
